entries.name: AI PORTRAIT STUDIO
entries.line: Step in, smile, and receive yourself reimagined: in national dress, as an oil painting, as a constellation, in ink and calligraphy.
entries.moment: One photo and a curated, artist-approved style. Seconds later the portrait lands on the guest's phone and joins a live gallery wall the whole crowd watches grow. Every style is art-directed by us for your theme, so results stay on-brand and culturally right. Consent is built into the flow.
entries.best: National occasions · Employee events · Exhibitions · Brand activations

entries.name: WORDS INTO ART
entries.line: A guest's own word, name or everyday phrase, transformed into calligraphy, illustration or verse before their eyes.
entries.moment: Type a wish, a name, a line of everyday speech. The wall answers with your words rendered in an artist-approved hand: as calligraphy, as illustration, or lifted into a line of verse. Each piece is moderated, multilingual and printable as a keepsake card, and all of them join one collective artwork.
entries.best: Cultural festivals · Biennales · Brand events · Ramadan & National Day

entries.name: CONSTELLATION OF FACES
entries.line: Every guest's photo becomes one tile in a luminous collective portrait. Your emblem, made of your people.
entries.moment: Portraits gathered before or during the event are composed into one shimmering image: a great star, your emblem, a national symbol. On the main screen the constellation forms, breathes and resolves while the room watches itself appear. It closes a ceremony better than a speech, and the film is yours to keep.
entries.best: Employee days · National occasions · Anniversaries · Graduations

entries.name: EXECUTIVE BRIEFING AI
entries.line: A private station for VIPs. Ask a serious question and receive a plain-language answer drawn only from your approved sources.
entries.moment: A quiet desk set apart from the floor, made for visitors whose time is short. They ask a serious question aloud, about the strategy, the numbers or the programme, and receive a clear spoken answer with the supporting facts on screen. Every answer is drawn only from sources you have approved, and nothing is improvised.
entries.best: VIP lounges · Government showcases · Investor days · Headquarters

entries.name: HERO MAKER
entries.line: Scan a code, take a selfie, and become the campaign's hero character, ready to share. No app and no booth.
entries.moment: A code on the pack, the poster or the shelf. Scan it, take one selfie, and seconds later you are the hero of the campaign: drawn in its style, dressed in its world, ready to post. There is no app to install and no booth to staff, so it runs in a thousand stores at once.
entries.best: FMCG & retail campaigns · Malls · Film & game launches · Festivals

entries.name: FUTURE SELF
entries.line: A portrait of who you could become. Visitors see themselves in the professions and worlds of tomorrow.
entries.moment: A student steps up and meets herself fifteen years from now: an astronaut, a surgeon, an architect of cities not yet built. The portrait is recognisably her, which is what makes it land. It prints as a keepsake and arrives on her phone, and for a national vision or a careers fair it makes the future personal.
entries.best: Education & careers fairs · National vision showcases · Science centres · Youth events

entries.name: COMPASS KIOSK
entries.line: Two quick questions, one personal recommendation: which zone, which artist, which product to see next.
entries.moment: Two quick questions on a slim kiosk: what are you in the mood for, and how much time do you have? It answers with one personal recommendation: the zone to visit, the artist to hear, the product to try, with the route to get there. A big programme becomes a personal one, and quieter corners get their share of visitors.
entries.best: Festivals · Large exhibitions · Malls · Museums

entries.name: AI HOST
entries.line: A conversational on-screen character that knows your content, for reception desks, stands and showrooms.
entries.moment: A character on a screen who actually listens. Visitors ask in Arabic or English, where to go, what is on, what the product does, and the host answers in a natural voice, in your brand's manner. It knows only what you have taught it, never tires, and hands over to a human the moment one is needed.
entries.best: Reception desks · Exhibition stands · Showrooms · Visitor centres

entries.name: LIVE DEMO DESKS
entries.line: Hosted AI demo stations on a shared schedule, so every studio and booth in a zone is visibly alive all day.
entries.moment: A zone full of technology is only convincing when something is happening in it. We set up hosted demo desks across the zone and run them to a shared timetable: a live build here at eleven, a creative session there at twelve. Whenever a visitor or a camera crew walks through, something real is going on.
entries.best: Technology zones · Innovation districts · Conferences · Campus open days

entries.name: THE MIMIC
entries.line: A character on screen copies every move you make, in your brand's skin.
entries.moment: Step in front of the screen and a character steps in with you: a mascot, an astronaut, a figure in traditional dress, a robot. Wave and it waves; dance and it dances; walk away and it waves goodbye. It is body tracking with no instructions, and children treat it as a friend within seconds. The character is yours to design.
entries.best: Family zones · Mascot & character brands · Malls · Sports events

cats.name: SOUND, LIGHT & SCENT
cats.blurb: Atmospheres you feel before you notice them. The quietest work we do, and often the most remembered.

entries.name: THE PORTALS
entries.line: A colonnade of illuminated arches, each a portal with its own film, colour, soundscape and scent.
entries.moment: A row of arches, one for each chapter of your story: seven emirates, five products, four decades. Walking through each one changes the light on your skin, the sound around you and the scent in the air. The walk resolves in a final portal where everything comes together. Modular, coherent and the most photographed spot on site.
entries.best: National celebrations · Festivals · Brand worlds · Destination launches

entries.name: SCENT LANDSCAPE
entries.line: Sculptural mountains that each become a fragrance world through light, sound and a breath of scent.
entries.moment: A desert of sculpted forms linked by paths of light. Each mountain wears its own abstract projection: ember cooling into frost, rose-gold silk, slow mineral pulses. It releases its scent only as you approach. At intervals the whole room performs one synchronised show, then returns to quiet. Built in modules, so it tours.
entries.best: Fragrance & beauty launches · Luxury retail · Pop-ups · Touring exhibitions

entries.name: WHISPERING POINTS
entries.line: Stories you can only hear when you stand in exactly the right spot, as if the place were telling you a secret.
entries.moment: A small brass marker in the ground, and nothing else to see. Step onto it and a voice speaks close to your ear, telling the story of exactly where you are standing. Step off and it is gone; the person beside you heard nothing. It fills a heritage site with stories without adding a single sign or screen.
entries.best: Heritage sites · Museums · Gardens & trails · Old-town districts

entries.name: LISTENING TREES
entries.line: Shaded seats under trees that quietly play stories, music or poetry all day. Press the button for the featured piece.
entries.moment: A bench in the shade of a tree, and voices in the air, quiet enough that you only hear them once you sit down. Stories, music or poetry play softly all day. Press the single brass button and the featured piece begins, read by its author. It gives a festival its resting places, and gives people a reason to stay in them.
entries.best: Festivals · Parks & campuses · Heritage districts · Hospital gardens

entries.name: CALL BOOTHS
entries.line: Vintage phone booths. Lift the handset and a founder, a legend or a character is on the line.
entries.moment: A row of vintage phone booths, and one of them is ringing. Lift the handset and someone is on the line: a founder recalling the first day, a champion reliving the final, a character from the story with a secret to pass on. Dial another number for another voice. Everybody photographs the booth, and everybody listens to the end.
entries.best: Festivals · Museums · Brand anniversaries · Retail

entries.name: LISTENING LINE
entries.line: Brass handsets on a timber rail, each holding sixty seconds of a real person's story.
entries.moment: A long timber rail with a row of brass handsets resting on it. Each holds sixty seconds of one real voice: a pearl diver's grandson, a first employee, a nurse on her first night shift. Visitors lift one, then another, and another. Without a screen in sight, it is the most personal wall in the building.
entries.best: Museums · Corporate heritage · Hospitals & universities · Memorials

entries.name: ORCHESTRA TABLE
entries.line: Touch pods for voice, strings, percussion and atmosphere. Mix your own version of the soundtrack and take it home.
entries.moment: A round table of glowing pods: one for the voice, one for the strings, one for percussion, one for the sea. Press and turn them to bring each layer in and out, and you are conducting your own arrangement of the piece: an anthem, a poem, the sound of a brand. When it sounds right, scan the code and take your mix home.
entries.best: Music & cultural festivals · Museums · Children's zones · Brand pavilions

entries.name: SOUND CHAMBER
entries.line: A sculpture that turns claps, voices and music into travelling light.
entries.moment: Clap, and a ring of light runs away from you through the sculpture. Sing, and the colour follows your pitch. A group can play it like an instrument, and when musicians perform inside it the whole structure becomes their visualiser. It makes sound visible, which no one can resist testing.
entries.best: Music & arts festivals · Science centres · Public plazas · Family zones

entries.name: SIGNAL CEREMONY
entries.line: A nightly ritual. Light pulses across every part of the site, zone after zone, and converges on a single landmark.
entries.moment: Every night at the same minute, the site stops. A pulse of light starts at the far gate and travels zone by zone, across every installation and every façade, until all of it converges on one landmark, which answers with a final bloom of light. It lasts three minutes, and it is what people arrange to come back for.
entries.best: Multi-zone festivals · Destinations · National celebrations · Campuses

entries.name: DATA WEATHER
entries.line: Architectural light that drifts with live data such as time, crowd and weather, so the building feels quietly aware.
entries.moment: The light in the building is never quite the same twice. It warms as the afternoon crowd builds, cools as the evening empties, and ripples when the wind picks up outside. Nobody needs to know why; people only feel that the space is quietly aware of them. For those who ask, a small panel says what it is listening to.
entries.best: Headquarters · Experience centres · Hospitality · Airports

entries.name: THE EMBRACE
entries.line: A gentle sensory journey for places of care: honey-warm light, a resting heartbeat, soft calligraphy and native scent.
entries.moment: A sequence of gentle stations made for places of care. Honey-warm light that slows to the pace of a resting heartbeat. Soft calligraphy that appears like breath on glass. The scent of native plants after rain. Nothing flashes and nothing demands. It is designed with clinicians, for mothers, patients and the people who look after them.
entries.best: Hospitals · Maternity & wellness centres · Commemorative days · Quiet rooms

entries.name: TIDE LIGHT
entries.line: A still sculpture at the centre, shoreline light washing the floor around it. The object appears to have risen from the sea.
entries.moment: One still sculpture at the centre of the room, and a tide of light that washes in across the floor around it, breaks softly against its base, and draws back. The sound of the shore moves with it. The object seems to have just risen from the sea, and visitors stand at the edge of the water to look.
entries.best: Sculpture & art launches · Jewellery · Hotel lobbies · Museums

entries.name: MEMORY CHAMBER
entries.line: A quiet room of shadows, silhouettes and voices. Less a screen than a place remembering.
entries.moment: A dim room where the walls seem to remember. Silhouettes pass across them: a family at the shore, a craftsman at his bench, children running. Voices come and go, close to the ear. There is no screen to watch and nothing to read. It is the room in the exhibition where people stop talking.
entries.best: Museums · Heritage houses · Memorials · Corporate heritage

entries.name: LIVING FAÇADE
entries.line: A building greets arrivals with a slow wash of light and a single hand-drawn line of welcome that appears, then dissolves.
entries.moment: As evening falls, the building takes a slow breath of light. Warmth rises across the façade, holds, and settles. Then a single hand-drawn line of calligraphy, a blessing or a welcome, writes itself across the stone, stays for a moment, and dissolves. It greets everyone who arrives, without ever becoming a billboard.
entries.best: Hospitals · Cultural buildings · Hotels · National occasions

entries.name: THE WHISPERING WALL
entries.line: Put your ear to the wall and hear its stories; whisper your own and it keeps them.
entries.moment: A textured wall with a few worn spots where people have leaned in. Put your ear to one and a voice speaks, close and quiet: a memory, a legend, a story of this place. Put your mouth to another and whisper your own, and the wall keeps it for the next visitor. Over a festival it fills with hundreds of voices, a listening archive nobody sees.
entries.best: Heritage festivals · Museums · Memorials & anniversaries · Libraries

entries.name: THE DRUM CIRCLE
entries.line: Ten drums around a globe of light; the harder the crowd plays, the more the world turns green.
entries.moment: A ring of drums around a globe of light. Each drum stands for a place or a cause; strike it and a wave of light runs from the drum to the globe, which turns a little greener with every beat. Leave the drums quiet and the world fades back to red. A crowd learns the rule in seconds and plays until the whole planet glows. It says together without a word.
entries.best: Sustainability & climate events · Schools · Festivals · Team days

cats.name: VR, AR & MIXED REALITY
cats.blurb: Headsets and phones as windows. Best when they are wrapped in something physical.

entries.name: TAKE FLIGHT
entries.line: Take to the air as a falcon, a seabird or a drone: a flight over your own landscape, with wind on your face.
entries.moment: One ride, two scales. Seated with a headset, it is a compact, high-throughput crowd-pleaser. On the full rig, a motion platform, wind and scent are synchronised to the flight for a whole-body dive. A sculptural arch, a falcon's wings in our first design, brands the zone and gives the queue something to photograph.
entries.best: National celebrations · Tourism stands · Festivals · Museums

entries.name: FUTURE CITIES VR
entries.line: Stand inside the city of tomorrow. A headset journey through a visionary skyline, built around your masterplan or national vision.
entries.moment: Put on the headset and you are standing in a city that has not been built yet. Gardens climb the towers, the streets are quiet and shaded, and the view stretches to the sea. It is built around your masterplan or national vision, seated and hosted, so every guest from a schoolchild to a minister can take the journey.
entries.best: National celebrations · Masterplan launches · Government showcases · Festivals

entries.name: MOTION VR
entries.line: Virtual reality on a moving platform, for rides, simulators and training with real physical feedback.
entries.moment: The headset shows the world and the seat makes you believe it. The platform banks with the aircraft, shudders over the dunes and drops with the rollercoaster, in step with every frame. For entertainment it is a ride people queue for. For training it is the nearest thing to the real vehicle, with none of the risk.
entries.best: Festivals & attractions · Automotive & aviation · Training centres · Malls

entries.name: MIXED REALITY SHOWCASE
entries.line: Digital objects placed convincingly in the real room and explored through a headset or tablet.
entries.moment: Through the headset the room looks exactly as it is, except that a full-size car is now parked on the carpet. Walk around it, open the door, change its colour, lift the body to see the chassis. When the real thing is too big, too costly or not built yet, it can still be in the room.
entries.best: Automotive · Real estate · Industrial equipment · Trade shows

entries.name: AR LAYERS
entries.line: Point a phone at a product, a poster or a building and its hidden layer appears.
entries.moment: Point a phone at the poster and it starts to move. Point it at the building and you see it as it stood a century ago. Point it at the pack and the recipe assembles itself on your kitchen counter. The hidden layer opens from a simple code, with no app to download.
entries.best: Packaging & print · Heritage sites · Retail · Tourism

entries.name: AR PHOTO MOMENT
entries.line: Guests pose with a creature or character that isn't there, framed and branded, ready to share.
entries.moment: Guests open the camera and a creature that is not there steps into the frame beside them: an Arabian oryx on a desert road, a champion horse at the races. They pose, snap and share, with your frame and your name on every picture. We have delivered it for a wildlife reserve and for a racing anniversary, straight from the browser.
entries.best: Events & festivals · Tourism · Retail · Sponsor activations
entries.client: AL MARMOOM RESERVE · DUBAI WORLD CUP 30TH

entries.name: WEBXR GALLERY
entries.line: An exhibition that lives on after the event: walkable in any browser, and ready for VR.
entries.moment: When the exhibition closes, it opens online. Visitors walk the same galleries in a browser, stop in front of each work, zoom into the detail and hear the curator speak. With a headset they can stand in the room. It extends a four-week show into a permanent one, open to the whole world.
entries.best: Biennales & art fairs · Museums · Galleries · Universities

entries.name: VR PAINT STUDIO
entries.line: Paint in the air around you and walk through your own drawing.
entries.moment: Put on the headset and the room is your canvas. Strokes of light hang in the air where you draw them; step around them, walk through them, build a garden or a galaxy. Onlookers watch your painting grow on the screen beside you, and the finished piece is filmed as a flight through it and sent home. Artists love it; so do six-year-olds.

entries.name: VR ARENA
entries.line: Multiplayer virtual sport: table tennis, and more, against the person beside you.
entries.moment: Two headsets, two players, one virtual table. Table tennis first, because everyone knows it and the physics feel true; then archery, boxing, a fast-ball game with the crowd's scores on the wall. Players stand in the real room a metre apart and meet inside the game. It is the VR that people queue for twice.
entries.best: Sports events · Malls · Team days · Gaming & tech launches

Scanning one unlocks the animal in a personal gallery, plays its film in Arabic or English, and brings it to life in augmented reality. A leaderboard turned a drive into a hunt, and live data showed the client exactly how visitors moved.

Finishing the trail unlocks an AR photo with their companion, a 3D racing game keeps them playing, and organisers watch it all on a live dashboard.

entries.name: FESTIVAL COMPANION

entries.moment: One link at the gate and the whole event is in the visitor's hand: what is on now, where it is, and the story behind the piece in front of them. As they explore they collect keepsakes, poems, portraits and stamps, which stay with them after they leave. Organisers see what is busy, what is quiet, and what people loved.

entries.name: DIGITAL PASSPORT
entries.line: Stamps collected by scanning at each venue. Five, ten, all of them: each milestone unlocks a reward and a title.
entries.moment: Every venue has a stamp, and every visitor has a passport on their phone. Scan at the door and the stamp drops onto the page with a satisfying thud. Five stamps earns a title, ten earns a reward, the full set earns a place on the wall of explorers. It turns a district of separate venues into one journey.

entries.name: COLLECT-A-WORD TRAIL
entries.line: Each venue gives up one fragment. Across the month they assemble into a hidden word, and a finale made by everyone.
entries.moment: Each venue hides one fragment: a single stroke, a letter, a piece of a pattern. Visitors collect them on their phones across the weeks of the event, and slowly a hidden word takes shape. On the closing night, every completed word joins a finale artwork made by everyone who walked the trail.

entries.name: POCKET QUIZ
entries.line: A self-paced quiz on guests' own phones, with a live leaderboard and winners announced at the close.
entries.moment: Guests scan a code at their table and the quiz opens on their own phone: questions about the organisation, the year, each other. They play at their own pace through the event while the leaderboard on the big screen keeps shifting. The winners are announced from the stage, and everyone learns something on the way.

entries.name: NATIVE EVENT APP

It returns year after year, and it grows with each edition.

entries.moment: While the event is running, you can see it working: how many people have joined, which stations are busy, where the queue is forming, which film is watched to the end. Afterwards the same numbers arrive as a plain-language report, ready to hand to sponsors and stakeholders. It comes with every app and trail we deliver.

entries.name: REGISTRATION & FLOW
entries.line: Registration, QR entry and live attendance, sized for sites that expect a hundred thousand visitors.
entries.moment: Visitors register in a minute and receive a code. At the gate it is scanned in a second, and the site knows who has arrived, which gate is under pressure and how full each zone is. It is sized for the evenings when a hundred thousand people turn up, and it feeds the same live dashboard as everything else.

entries.name: KEEPSAKE CLAIM
entries.line: Whatever a guest makes on site, a portrait, a poem or a mix, waits for them online under a short code.
entries.moment: Everything a guest makes during the visit, a portrait, a poem, a music mix, a photograph with a falcon, is waiting for them afterwards. A short code on a card or a wristband opens their personal page, ready to download and share. The experience leaves the venue with them, carrying your name.

entries.name: THE JOURNEY TAG

entries.moment: A guest registers at the entrance and receives a tag: a wristband, a card, a keepsake. Every installation has a reader; tap it and the visit is recorded, the content personalised, the score kept. At the exit, a final tap produces something made only for them: a printed summary, a portrait, a certificate, a film of their day. Behind it, the organiser sees exactly how people moved.
entries.best: Exhibition stands · Experience centres · Conferences · Museums

entries.name: THE CLICKABLE MUSEUM
entries.line: A hand-drawn cutaway of the museum. Tap a number and step inside a gallery.
entries.moment: The whole fort in one illustration, with every space a single tap away. Pinch to zoom, switch between English and Arabic, read what each gallery holds. One build serves the touch podium on a trade-show stand and the museum's iPads, and is ready to embed in its website. It returns to the start screen by itself when a visitor walks away.

entries.name: THE DISTRICT MAP
entries.line: An illustrated, living map of a whole creative district, embedded in the client's own website.
entries.moment: Every gallery, studio and café sits on one hand-crafted map: searchable, filterable by category, fully bilingual. Venues cluster into neighbourhoods and open into cards with photographs, hours and directions. It is engineered to live inside government and enterprise websites and to pass their security review.

entries.client: AL QUOZ CREATIVE ZONE · DUBAI CULTURE

entries.name: ATLAS PODIUMS
entries.line: The same map that lives in visitors' pockets, installed as touch podiums at anchor venues.
entries.moment: At each anchor venue stands a slim podium with the whole district on it. Visitors tap the map to see what is nearby, what is open now and how to walk there, then send the route to their phone. It is the same map that lives in their pocket, so whatever venues update appears everywhere at once.

entries.name: MAP WALL
